Rhea (Billing): FYI payment gateway alerted for a refund burst on merchant BrightList (acct_BL009). 6 refunds in 90m. gateway_event ge_20260323_11.
Jon (Risk): Any pattern on amounts or original charges?
Rhea (Billing): Mix of $25 and $250 refunds, two from same charge id ch_BX77. Merchant metadata shows batch_id: br_batch_03023.
refund-bot: Auto-flag: refund_velocity_exceeded for acct_BL009; risk score 78%. Recommend hold payouts.
Aarav (FinOps): Put payouts on hold. Need merchant confirmation before reversal. Also want ledger snapshot.
Sam (Support): Reached out to merchant rep (support@brightlist.ai) asking if these were manual refunds or system retry. Waiting on their reply.
Jon (Risk): Action list: 1) Pull gateway webhook logs + delivery timestamps; 2) Compare to merchant refund CSV; 3) Prepare dispute-ready evidence if cardholders complain.
Rhea (Billing): Uploaded provisional evidence folder /shared/finance/brightlist/1914328110 and added portal note: "refund burst under review".
Aarav (FinOps): If merchant confirms accidental duplicates, we can propose reversal for duplicates only. Approve provisional reversal up to $1,000.
Sam (Support): Merchant replied: "we ran a batch refund job twice due to a scheduler hiccup. Attaching job logs and invoice list." They said they'll sign affidavit.
Jon (Risk): Good. Hold stays until logs + signed affidavit are in shared folder. If we get that, process reversals for duplicated txns and update ledger.
Rhea (Billing): I'll validate the CSV vs gateway events and mark duplicates. ETA 3 hours.
Aarav (FinOps): Noted. Keep legal on standby if any cardholder disputes appear.
Jon (Risk): Closing loop once evidence verified. Thanks everyone.
